text: Himo yaltina ko wuuri e nder ko maayi; wano tagirgol neɗɗo immorde e toɓɓere maniiyu maa yaltinirgol cofun e nder woofoonde, Himo yaltina kadi ko maayi e nder ko wuuri, wano tagirgol Mo toɓɓere maniiyu nden immorde e neɗɗo maa woofoonde nden immorde e gertogal ngal. Himo wuurnitira leydi ndin jippingol toɓo fuɗina ndi ɓaawo ndi yoorude. Ko wano ndin leydi wuurnitiraa non fuɗingol ndi, yaltinirteɗon e genaale maon fii hasbeede yoɓee.
